parameters.name: num_products
parameters.description: Number of products in the finite product set

parameters.name: num_resources
parameters.description: Number of resources in the finite resource set

parameters.name: planning_horizon
parameters.description: Identifiers for the single planning horizon period set

parameters.name: resource_consumption
parameters.description: Resource consumption per unit of each product for each resource

parameters.name: tier_lower_bound
parameters.description: Lower bound of each sales-volume tier for each product

parameters.name: tier_upper_bound
parameters.description: Optional upper bound of each sales-volume tier for each product; missing upper bounds are open-ended

parameters.name: tier_unit_profit
parameters.description: Unit profit associated with each sales-volume tier for each product

parameters.name: num_tiers_per_product
parameters.description: Number of ordered tiers available for each product

variables.name: production_quantity
variables.description: Planned production and sales quantity of each product

variables.name: selected_tier
variables.description: Selected sales-volume tier index for each product

variables.name: tier_indicator
variables.description: Binary indicator of whether a tier is active for a product

variables.name: total_profit
variables.description: Total profit of the selected production plan

constraints.name: nonnegative_production_quantity
constraints.description: production quantity for each product must be nonnegative

constraints.name: binary_tier_indicator
constraints.description: tier indicator variables are binary when the indicator representation is used

constraints.name: single_period_planning
constraints.description: all production and resource usage decisions apply to the single planning horizon
constraints.formula: \text{All decisions are made for the single horizon } \mathcal{T}

constraints.name: resource_capacity_limit_linear
constraints.description: Total resource usage from all products must not exceed each resource capacity

constraints.name: single_active_tier_per_product_linear
constraints.description: Exactly one sales-volume tier is active for each product

constraints.name: tier_order_and_profit_monotonicity
constraints.description: Tier intervals are ordered and higher-volume tiers have weakly lower unit profit

constraints.name: tier_upper_bound_activation
constraints.description: Production quantity cannot exceed the upper bound of the active tier; the final tier may be open-ended so only finite upper bounds are enforced
constraints.formula: x_p \le \sum_{k\in \mathcal{K}_p:\, u_{p,k}\neq \text{null}} u_{p,k} y_{p,k} + M_p\left(1-\sum_{k\in \mathcal{K}_p:\, u_{p,k}=\text{null}} y_{p,k}\right) \quad \forall p\in \mathcal{P}

constraints.name: tier_selection_position_link
constraints.description: Selected tier position equals the position implied by the active tier indicators

constraints.name: tier_profit_definition
constraints.description: Total profit equals the sum of active tier unit profits times product quantities

constraints.name: tier_order_and_profit_monotonicity_linear
constraints.description: Tier intervals are ordered and higher-volume tiers have weakly lower unit profit

constraints.name: resource_capacity_limit_linearized
constraints.description: Total resource usage from all products must not exceed each resource capacity

constraints.name: single_active_tier_per_product_linearized
constraints.description: Exactly one sales-volume tier is active for each product

constraints.name: tier_bounds_big_m
constraints.description: Production quantity must lie within the lower and upper bounds of the active tier using big-M activation

constraints.name: selected_tier_position
constraints.description: Selected tier index is represented as the active tier position

objectives.name: total_profit_maximization
objectives.description: maximize total profit of the production plan

final_objective.description: maximize total profit from production quantities with tier selection encoded by binary indicators
